importantNotes: 'The righteous shall live by faith' (2:4) — quoted three times in the NT (Rom 1:17, Gal 3:11, Heb 10:38).
Habakkuk teaches that it's okay to bring honest questions to God.
The five 'woes' in chapter 2 warn against greed, exploitation, violence, and idolatry.
Habakkuk 3:17-19 is one of the greatest expressions of faith regardless of circumstances.
The book moves from questioning to trusting — a model for believers facing confusing times.

chapters.1: Habakkuk asks why God allows injustice; God replies He is raising up Babylon.
chapters.2: 'The righteous shall live by faith'; five woes against Babylon's wickedness.
chapters.3: Habakkuk's prayer and song of faith — 'Yet I will rejoice in the LORD.'
